CHAPTER 34 Medical Nutrition Therapy for Pulmonary Disease 
Alpha-1 antitrypsin deficiency is present in 1% to 2% of 
COPD patients and is likely underrecognized. COPD exacerba-
tions can be caused by Haemophilus influenzae, Moraxella ca-
tarrhalis, S. pneumonia, rhinovirus, coronavirus, and to a lesser 
degree, organisms such as P. aeruginosa, S. aureus, Mycoplasma 
spp., and Chlamydia pneumoniae. Allergies, smoking, congestive 
heart failure, pulmonary embolism, pneumonia, and systemic 
infections are the reason for 20% to 40% of COPD exacerba-
tions (Nakawah et al, 2013).
